models.basis: START (sparse-terrain locomotion with height-map reconstruction) based velocity-command locomotion policy
models.internal_name: canon 3 (EX-42 stage E1F, local checkpoint model_250.pt)

iterations.note: The checkpoint key 'iter' stores the local count 250. Cumulative 15500 = parent 15250 + 250.

network.perception_module: depth image to height-map reconstruction (perception_state_dict); actor reads latent map features

environment.action: joint position targets as offsets from default pose (scale 0.25, 12 joints)

related.onnx_for_robot: inbox/jay/20261103-policy-handoff/start-m15500-app/ (start-m15500_map_on.onnx, start-m15500_map_off.onnx, same sha256 checkpoint as start-m15500.pt)

models.basis: AME-2 based Go2 reproduction: goal-position locomotion policy (teacher) that attends over a ground-truth height map with an active gaze crop, reproduced on Unitree Go2 in Isaac Lab from the public AME-2 code (leggedrobotics/ame2_minimal)
models.internal_name: ame2-m27001 (app bundle name) = tp424_in_p1_s5_from17000/model_16999.pt, weight average of the final checkpoints of runs tp424_p1_s4 and tp424_p2_s4
models.policy_role_note: Teacher: the actor reads privileged inputs (base linear velocity and a ground-truth height map from simulator ray casts). No student for this line has been trained yet.

iterations.note: File named model_27000.pt by the deliverable layout; the exact cumulative count is 27001 = 10001 updates of the start checkpoint (go2_env_state.start_from.source_completed_updates) + 17000 updates counted from it (go2_env_state.completed_updates). The checkpoint key 'iter' stores 16999 (index of the last update). The run folder name tp424_in_p1_s5_from17000 counts from the start checkpoint (completed_updates 17000), not cumulatively. From completed 15000 on, two runs (pod 1 and pod 2) each trained 500 updates from the same checkpoint and their weights were then averaged; this was repeated four times (N = 15000 + 500 s, s = 1..4); this checkpoint is the output of averaging 4 at N = 17000 (sync_record.txt).

framework.rl_library: rsl_rl 5.0.0 as vendored in leggedrobotics/ame2_minimal commit 8beb9a68 (byte-identical) with the FOOTHOLD Go2 runner (OnPolicyRunner)

algorithm.name: PPO
algorithm.seed_note: Seed of run tp424_p1_s4 whose params are shipped; the averaged partner run tp424_p2_s4 used seed 42.

network.critic: MoE 16 experts, input 446, hidden [512, 512], 20 outputs (one value per reward term)

environment.action: joint position targets as offsets from default pose (scale 0.25, 12 joints)
environment.command: goal pose (x, y, sin and cos of heading error) in the base yaw frame, clipped to 2 m

evaluation.benchmark: 12 terrains x 10 levels, 2400 robots, 5 counted episodes per robot (12000 counted episodes per seed), task Ame2-Go2-Gaze-N9P12-Eval5, success = reach the goal
evaluation.source: benchmark set evalgz_tpevf24_b1 run on 2026-11-18 with this checkpoint: 20261118T050827Z_21902/evg_tpa4p1_16999_s42.pt, 20261118T051720Z_22766/evg_tpa4p1_16999_s1001.pt, 20261118T052610Z_23637/evg_tpa4p1_16999_s2002.pt, 20261118T053504Z_24516/evg_tpa4p1_16999_s3003.pt; success counted over each robot's episodes except its first (5 per robot, the benchmark queue's check rule); per-terrain values computed from these files on 2026-11-20

averaging.method: arithmetic mean (float64 then cast back) of every actor and critic tensor and of Adam exp_avg / exp_avg_sq; learning rate = geometric mean; other entries (environment and curriculum state, counters) kept from the pod 1 source; the averaged parts digest 98b75f905d272e23836de70d027cbc10ae4ab8bc5152a724e06c487dfffc09e2
averaging.earlier_rounds: rounds 1..3 at N = 15500, 16000, 16500 averaged the two pods' 500-update segments the same way; segment 1 started from the single-run checkpoint model_14999 (completed 15000)

models.config_provenance: config_ame2.yaml = params/agent.yaml and params/env.yaml of the checkpoint folder tp424_in_p1_s5_from17000, which sync424.py copied from the pod 1 source run and checked by sha256 at copy time (sync424.py lines 234-237). sha256 measured on the training volume on 2026-11-19: env.yaml 48088f33708196c90c10d1e5b4971e6646796a718f3c1355e5afc68ea487c623 and agent.yaml 855b1b578eaded8aa3a4c8c167b364bdf51e501bea204646e85d4c3f91ca1530, equal in the checkpoint folder and in the pod 1 source run 2026-11-18_00-29-16_tp424_p1_s4_adam_fp32_4x3_from16500_to17000.
models.policy_role_evidence: experiment_name go2_gaze_teacher (agent.yaml line 15); actor obs_groups = teacher_mapping and teacher_prop (agent.yaml lines 7-10); teacher_prop includes base_lin_vel and teacher_mapping is the ground-truth ray-cast height map (config_ame2.yaml document 2, observations)
